title: Unlearned graph shows landing page and auto starts learning
summary: When a workspace has no injected onboarding notes, the dashboard must hide normal graph/dashboard surfaces and show a learning-in-progress landing page. Onboarding learning auto-starts from that landing via the enqueue/drain flow; there is no dismissible banner and no manual Start learning step. The review/inject gate remains after learning completes.
